text:
Maria: Quick sync — two customers saw dropped streaming tokens when clients reconnect after a transient network blip. Looking into quota accounting for partial responses.
Alex: Logs show router debits tokens on chunk emission, not on final ack. When clients reconnect and re-request same stream we sometimes double-charge.
Sam: Current behavior: runtime charges as soon as it emits tokens. If disconnect happens mid-stream, org/key already billed. Retry creates duplicate charge.
Maria: Options: debit on ack, hold in transient reservation, or use client-sent idempotency token for dedupe?
Kevin: Ack-per-chunk is expensive. For HTTP streaming or WS we don't have per-chunk ack. Could add final "stream_end" confirmation but that's a protocol change.
Alex: Proposal:
1) Reserve a short-lived credit for in-flight streams (reservation recorded in quota service).
2) If client reconnects within TTL and presents same stream_id, reconcile and refund duplicate consumption.
3) After TTL expires, reservation turns into final charge.
Maria: TTL? 10s? 30s?
Sam: Typical network flaps <5s; mobile is 10-20s. 30s safer but increases reserved exposure.
Kevin: Make TTL configurable per org. Default 15s; console toggle for mobile-heavy apps to extend.
Alex: Runtime changes: assign stream_id at accept time, persist reservation in quota service (fast in-memory + async durable write). Client can send X-Stream-Resume: <stream_id> on reconnect.
Maria: Console UX: show "reserved" credits separate from "consumed" with hover explaining TTL and auto-release time.
Kevin: Telemetry: add metrics streaming.reservations.active, streaming.reservations.finalize_latency, streaming.reconnects.by_org, streaming.duplicate_charges.detected.
Sam: Add audit/log line when refund happens: quota.reservation.refunded stream_id=... org=... reason=reconnect
Alex: Edge-case: old clients without stream_id. Fallback heuristics (token-window overlap) are risky; prefer conservative approach and absorb small duplicates for old clients.
Maria: Rollout: feature-flag gated, default off for existing prod orgs, enabled for new orgs. Canary 2 weeks on low-volume orgs.
Kevin: API header X-Stream-Resume and SDK helpers to surface resume token. Document in SDK changelog.
Alex: Owners: quota service (Sam), runtime (Alex), console + metrics (Kevin), SDK/docs (Maria).
Sam: I'll write the design doc with reservation schema (id, org, key, reserved_tokens, created_at, ttl, state) and simulation guidance. Use redis for fast lookups + kafka for async persistence.
Maria: Action items: Sam write doc, Alex open runtime PR, Kevin add grafana panels, Maria draft SDK/console copy. Target canary in 3 weeks.
dev-bot: Deploy scheduled: eng-platform/canary 2026-04-01 22:00 UTC (placeholder).
Maria: Thanks — ping here if you see other failure modes. :thumbsup:
